$comment: Operator decision log (scripts/analysis/decision-log.mjs; Spec 124 R-HK). Imported verbatim from the committed chat record docs/reports/decisions/raw/2026-10-20-chat-batch-a/2026-10-20-batch-a.json. `decision_vocab`, `routing` (the register and row that record each decision), `amendments` and `options` are added by the lane and are not the operator's text; everything else is re-derived from `source.raw` by `--check`.

decisions.question: LC-62 renovation section before owner input (R-12 as amended)
decisions.recommendation: On non-semi lots show the renovation figures that don't need owner input, labelled as estimates (existing footprint, how much it could grow back, basement area); ask for storeys only where a figure depends on them (addition up, attic). On half-semi lots no estimates at all (Q-2).

decisions.question: Front-yard averaging placement vs R-8 chain order
decisions.recommendation: Keep front-yard averaging in the scenario step (compute_maxbld_scenarios), as Spec 134 has it; do not move resolve_bylaws later in the chain.

decisions.question: R-HK decision-log mechanism
decisions.recommendation: Confirm R-HK: operator decisions are transferred via tracked decision logs + generator + pre-commit coverage lock (decision-log --check).

decisions.question: R-RS report surface declaration rule
decisions.recommendation: A product report surface has one field declaration; every field names exactly one source; a generator --check gates names, types, presentation and pending states; its outputs are generated, never hand-edited.

decisions.question: E2E-F-05 RS 10.40.40.20(4)(A) mis-citation
decisions.recommendation: Read 'Despite regulation 10.20.40.20(1)' as RS's own 10.40.40.20(1), as intended, so 19.0 m applies for a townhouse on a major street, with a disclosure noting the by-law's mis-citation.
